title: Ground Your Identity
coreMove: Ground the threatened identity belief before the conversation by making it complex enough to hold bad news.
sourcePressure: The chapter shows how all-or-nothing identity beliefs create identity quakes and how AND/BOTH grounding prepares the self-image to receive hard information.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Using AND/BOTH as self-soothing language that prevents feedback from leaving a mark.

sourceAnchors.name: identity quake
sourceAnchors.detail: The source uses this term for the destabilization that occurs when a conversation threatens competence, goodness, or worthiness of love.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: An identity quake can make a small sentence feel like a verdict on your whole self.

sourceAnchors.name: AND/BOTH
sourceAnchors.detail: The source frames grounded identity as the ability to hold competence with mistakes, goodness with bad effects, and worthiness with relationship trouble.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The AND is not a cushion; it is the hinge that lets hard information come in.
